messages:
Maya (People Ops): Drafting a super-compact manager+HR onboarding script for Chris's incoming SWE (Jordan) starting Tue. Keep replies short so we can close tonight.

Pre-arrival checklist (today):
- Confirm legal name + display name (Chris).
- ID uploaded to HR portal (Jordan).
- Device + badge: Julian to confirm courier vs front desk.
- Add to Slack: #eng-team, #infra, #new-hires.
- Create OnboardBot checklist and tag Tess as buddy.

Day 1 (no heavy onboarding):
- 09:30: Quick HR admin + benefits (Maya, 15m).
- 11:00: Team coffee & intros (20m)  no slides.
- 13:00: Systems access + console tour (Tess).
- 15:00: 1:1 with manager (Chris)  set 30d priorities and communication norms.
- Micro task: pick one failing test and write notes on root cause + next step.

Week 1 targets:
- Complete SSO/MFA, security training, and codebase readme.
- Shadow one incident review or customer demo.
- Submit 1-page "first-impressions" doc with 3 suggested focus areas.

30/60/90 bullets (paste in 1:1):
- 30d: Ship small bugfix/cleanup and understand release pipeline.
- 60d: Lead a small feature patch and measure effect.
- 90d: Drive a measurable reliability or dev-flow improvement.

Logistics & links:
- HR portal: https://hr.redwood.local/onboard (Maya)
- Badge pickup: lobby or courier (Julian)
- Console access: /forms/console-access (Chris include GitHub handle)

Chris (Eng Manager): Sending intro email now. Tess confirmed buddy slot at 13:00. Can Maya add a day-3 check-in to the checklist?

Maya (People Ops): Done  I added day-3 and day-7 reminders and created OnboardBot checklist OB-1745670001: https://onboard.redwood.local/checklist/OB-1745670001

Julian (IT): Laptop imaged (14" MBP). Pickup 09:00 or I can courier. Need GitHub handle for team mapping and phone for MFA, or we can issue a hardware key.

Tess (Buddy): I'll prepare a short walkthrough: repo layout, CI flow, and one recent incident for shadowing. Also adding a template for the 1-page impressions.

OnboardBot: Checklist OB-1745670001 created and reminders scheduled. Tasks: device, HR forms, console access, buddy check-ins.

Maya (People Ops): Closing pre-arrival items unless blockers. Reply here if anything changes overnight. :thumbsup:
